assumptions: change sets apply to the baseline they were authored against (docs/scope/lean-slice.md)

decisions.reason: Chose daily aggregate click counts per link: meets the need without collecting personal data about who clicks.
Design follows clarified option A (aggregate counts only, no personal data); approved to apply in isolated workspace.
Tests passed with 0 failures, no open high threats, privacy policy checks passed. Release approved.

limitations: metrics are demonstration data from a single workstation

plan_and_rationale.approach: Add daily aggregate click counts per link (UTC day) at GET /api/v1/links/{code}/stats/daily; no visitor personal data.
plan_and_rationale.requirement: SCN-C option A: Daily aggregate click counts

trade_offs: deterministic rule-based agents apply human-locked change sets instead of generating code at run time

releases are local (snapshot or local staging); merging into the repository stays a manual human action
